full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white surreal graphic image shows three dark figures spaced among tall white rectangular panels beneath a large pale moon. The upper third is almost black, with a smooth circular moon set left of center near the top. A thin band of cloudy gray sky runs below it, opening between the hard white panels. At the left edge, a man in a dark hat and coat appears in left-facing profile, cropped by the side and bottom of the panel. Near the center-right, a taller man in a brimmed hat and long dark jacket also faces left, standing before one of the white geometric slabs. Farther right, a smaller woman in a dark outfit and close-fitting hat stands in profile, her upper body visible against another pale slab. Their faces are lightly modeled, but most garments remain flat near-black silhouettes. Between the panels in the far distance, a narrow pointed tower rises from the horizon and several tiny human silhouettes stand nearby. The ground is dark and level, with hard-edged shadows extending across its surface. The vertical panels vary in height and width; one at the center ends lower than the blocks on either side, exposing more of the gray sky. The viewpoint is level and frontal, making the architecture appear like a staged arrangement rather than a continuous street. Light is cool and diffuse from the pale sky and moon, leaving strong black-white separation without visible warm color. The overall composition repeats left-facing profiles and upright rectangles beneath the detached circle, creating a still, enigmatic visual rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白超现实图形呈现三名深色人物，分散在高高的白色长方板之间，上方是一轮巨大的浅色月亮。上部三分之一近乎漆黑，平滑圆月位于靠近顶部、中央偏左。其下方一道灰色云天横带从硬边白板之间露出。左缘一名戴深色帽、穿深色外套的男子以向左侧脸出现，身形被画面侧边与底部裁去。中央偏右另一名较高男子戴有檐帽、穿深色长外套，也朝左站在一块白色几何板前。更右侧较小的女子穿深色衣服、戴贴头帽，以侧脸站在另一浅色板前，露出上半身。他们的脸有浅淡塑形，大部分衣物却保持近黑平面剪影。板间极远处，一座尖塔从地平线升起，旁边站着几名极小的人影。地面深暗且平坦，硬边阴影横过表面。竖板高宽不一；中央一块比两侧矮，露出更多灰天。视点平齐且正面，使建筑像舞台上的摆设，而非连续街道。光从浅色天空和月亮冷调漫射，让黑白分隔强烈，没有可见暖色。整体构图在独立圆形下方重复朝左侧脸与直立长方形，形成静止而难以捉摸的视觉节奏。
style_prompt_en: Surreal monochrome graphic design combines photographic silhouettes with simple hard-edged geometric panels. Near-black fields, cool middle grays, and flat white rectangles create strong value separation. A large pale circle floats above a low cloudy band, countering repeated vertical masses and small upright accents. Faces carry restrained natural modeling, while clothing and architecture simplify into crisp silhouettes. Diffuse cool illumination keeps broad surfaces even, but hard cast shapes deepen the ground plane. Wide gaps of negative space and unequal panel heights prevent a mechanical grid. The overall effect is staged, minimal, and quietly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实单色图形设计把摄影式剪影与简单硬边几何板结合起来。近黑色域、冷中灰和平坦白色长方形形成强烈明度分隔。一轮大而浅的圆形漂浮在低处云带之上，平衡重复竖向大形体和细小直立重音。面部保留克制自然塑形，衣物与结构则简化成清楚剪影。冷调漫射光让大面积表面均匀，但硬投影加深地面。宽阔负空间和不等高板块避免机械网格感。整体效果像舞台布置、极简而安静地诡异。
theme_en: Three dark figures among white geometric panels beneath a large pale moon
theme_zh: 三名深色人物位于白色几何板之间，上方是一轮巨大的浅月
name: Herbert Bayer
